finding.mechanism: Historical candidate scheduling uses source_count as a secondary priority, while repeated replay/chunk variants can represent the same source_event_id. Counting repeated provenance as fresh source weight can bias the 39M-token backlog without adding independent evidence.
finding.counterhypothesis: The inflation is harmless because source_count is only a scheduling hint, not evidence authority.
finding.discriminator: Reconcile linked candidates to COUNT(DISTINCT source_event_id) and require a second identical reconciliation pass to produce zero changes while leaving unlinked legacy rows untouched.

delta.rule: For candidates with candidate_sources links, source_count is reconciled to COUNT(DISTINCT source_event_id) after historical ingestion. Candidates with no provenance links are not silently reinterpreted.

cases: same source_event_id across multiple chunks/extractors counts once
legacy candidate without candidate_sources links remains unchanged

next_exact_gate: Run the current branch plus historical-backfill suite on the authorized clay-direct-dev path and prove that a full second saturation pass does not increase source_count or accepted evidence weight for unchanged source_event_id provenance.
evidence_boundary: Local deterministic unit evidence verifies only the reconciliation invariant. It does not prove full historical saturation, exact-current clay-direct-dev runtime, EntityOS/HCU acceptance, J-Space model causality, or training readiness.
